_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows the boundary on a map; do not restate the coordinates.

description: Merges boundaries into one polygon: the union of include minus the union of exclude (e.g. three counties minus one city). Use it for sales territories, delivery zones and service areas. Up to 50 boundaries; costs 1 unit per boundary. Returns a GeoJSON Feature with area_km2. To describe an area in words instead, use create_area. Needs an API key or a connected account.

detail.description: Simplification relative to the boundary's size: low (~1,000 points across, maps and previews), medium (default, ~5,000), high (~25,000), full (unsimplified OSM).

items.description: Boundary id: r<OSM relation id> (e.g. r62422 for Berlin) or w<way id>. Also accepts R62422, relation/62422, -62422, an openstreetmap.org URL, wikidata:Q64 or iso:US-CA.
